description: A utility function 'formatLabel' designed to convert snake_case or underscored JSON keys into human-readable, title-cased labels with special handling for common acronyms. The function replaces underscores and spaces with single spaces, trims, splits into words, capitalizes each word, and uppercases known acronyms.

methods.name: formatLabel(key)
methods.description: Converts a snake_case or underscored label into Title Case with spaces, capitalizing words and uppercasing common acronyms for display purposes.
